## Why your local run and CI do not actually disagree

**They agree — you ran a different check.** `pnpm turbo typecheck` compiles each package's `tsc --noEmit`, which does not include `__tests__/`. The CI log shows that same step passing right above the failure: `Tasks: 45 successful, 45 total` — **your exact 45/45**. The ratchet then runs `scripts/ci/check-test-typecheck-ratchet.mts`, which probes test files through a separate `tsconfig.test-ratchet-probe.json`. Your 45/45 was real and so is the failure; the gate you skipped is the one that covers test files. Run `node scripts/ci/check-test-typecheck-ratchet.mts` locally before the next push.

## The fix

**Delete line 294.** It is redundant, not just untyped: `:293` already asserts `expect(toolContext.inboundSource).toBeUndefined()` on **the same object** — `makeRunner` passes that very `toolContext` in as `deps.toolContext` (`:58`, `:64`), and the local `const` is non-null-typed. You lose no coverage. If you would rather keep the second assertion explicit, `deps.toolContext?.inboundSource` also satisfies the checker.

**Do not raise the manifest** — the ratchet's own failure text says it only ratchets down.
